title: Usage by person
description: Tokens, requests and spend per person, counted across the API and the web UI together. Sourced from the gateway's own tables rather than Prometheus: LiteLLM's /metrics is an enterprise feature, and vLLM's metrics carry no user dimension.

options.content: Both surfaces are counted here. API calls attribute through the caller's key; chat attributes through the identity Open WebUI forwards, which `identity-proxy` puts in the request. **Spend is only money if the model has `input_cost_per_token`/`output_cost_per_token` set** — otherwise it is a consistent accounting unit over tokens. Rows are written when a request completes, so the current minute lags.

targets.rawSql: SELECT user_id AS "person", SUM(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) AS "tokens", SUM(prompt_tokens) AS "prompt", SUM(completion_tokens) AS "completion", SUM(api_requests) AS "requests", SUM(failed_requests) AS "failed", SUM(spend) AS "spend" FROM "LiteLLM_DailyUserSpend" WHERE date::timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY "tokens" DESC

SELECT date::timestamp AS "time", user_id AS metric, SUM(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) AS value FROM "LiteLLM_DailyUserSpend" WHERE date::timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date::timestamp AS "time", model AS metric, SUM(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) AS value FROM "LiteLLM_DailyUserSpend" WHERE date::timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Budget headroom -- who is close to their ceiling
panels.description: Spend against ceiling for the CURRENT budget window, which is why it does not follow the dashboard time range. A person at 100% is refused until their budget resets.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.user_id AS "person", u.spend AS "spend", u.max_budget AS "ceiling", CASE WHEN u.max_budget > 0 THEN ROUND((u.spend / u.max_budget * 100)::numeric, 1) ELSE NULL END AS "used %", u.budget_reset_at AS "resets" FROM "LiteLLM_UserTable" u WHERE u.max_budget IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Recent requests
panels.description: `user` is the internal identity (attribution); `end_user` is what the budget is checked against. On a chat request they should be the same address -- if end_user is empty, identity-proxy is not in that request's path.

targets.rawSql: SELECT "startTime" AS "time", COALESCE("user", '-') AS "user", COALESCE(end_user, '-') AS "end_user", model, total_tokens AS "tokens", spend FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE "startTime" BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY "startTime" DESC LIMIT 100
